name: feature-usage
description: Records which kit skills load, slash commands are typed and kit scripts run, one name-only row each (never prompts, arguments or code) in ~/.ai-dev-kit/usage/log, so no model is asked whether a feature was used. Observes only and adds no model-visible text. On/off and an optional one-line notice are switched with /kit-usage, the session-budget skill's usage.js or the install-kit --usage flag; /kit-usage report shows what ran and what never did (needs the session-budget skill). No network. Reads env: USERPROFILE, HOME.
